caption: The drawing depicts a single spur and its leather strap against a plain, light beige background. The spur is metal, featuring intricate, faintly engraved patterns, and has a large, multi-pointed rowel wheel attached at one end. The metal components are a dark brownish-bronze color, suggesting aged or oxidized metal. The spur is attached to a thick, dark brown leather strap, which is curved and open, showing both its textured exterior and smoother interior. A metal button or stud secures the strap, and a small metal chain hangs loosely from the bottom edge of the spur. The objects are positioned centrally and slightly angled, with no additional elements in the composition. The signature "V. Van Voris" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Spur
